prompt: This flat vector illustration depicts a crisp winter afternoon in a bustling town square covered in smooth white snow. On the far left, a tall lamppost with a glowing yellow bulb stands next to a woman in a blue coat who is shivering slightly while holding a steaming mug. In the center of the scene, a large stone fountain is frozen solid, serving as a perch for a small gray cat that sits calmly atop the icy rim. To the right of the fountain, a man in a red scarf points enthusiastically toward the sky, drawing the attention of a child in a green hat who looks up with wide eyes. Behind them, a brown dog trots happily through the snow, its tail wagging mid-stride. Near the bottom right corner, an elderly person in a beige trench coat sits on a wooden bench, watching the scene unfold with a gentle smile. The background features simple geometric buildings with triangular roofs dusted in white, creating a clean and organized urban landscape. There is no visible text or signage anywhere in the image. The composition relies on bold colors and simple shapes to define the characters and setting without intricate shading or realistic textures. The woman in the blue coat is positioned to the left of the central fountain, while the man in the red scarf stands to its right. The child in the green hat is directly beside the man, following his gesture. The brown dog moves between the fountain and the bench, connecting the central and right areas of the square visually. The gray cat remains stationary on the fountain, providing a focal point in the middle ground.
